remarks:
New Price! $229,900! Brand New 200 Amp electrical box, outside line and meter! Meticulously maintained and cherished for over 60 years, this lovely LeRoy Village home has been the site of many happy memories. Built in 1872 this home has had multiple updates over the years. The lathe and plaster was replaced with insulation and drywall (some rooms done in the last 3-5 years). Vinyl replacement windows added, laundry was moved to the second floor. The first floor has an office/den that acts as a 5th bedroom when needed. The kitchen, overlooking the back yard, has beautiful cherry cabinets, updated counters and floors and opens into the formal dining room that seats 8+ guests. Upstairs, the hardwood floors are exposed in the 4 generous bedrooms. The laundry room is an actual Room, with enough floors space for a folding table, drying racks or winter clothes storage. Located at the end of the 2nd floor hallway and above the 1st floors bath...it is the perfect location to add a second bath.
The multi-zoned boiler saves you money by allowing you to keep the temperature cooler on the second floor and still be cozy on the first. Drywall and extra insulation translate to lower energy costs than you would expect in a beautiful turn of the century home. The 2024 gas bill budget was $106. a month. The Village of LeRoy, with it's many sidewalks, is considered a great "walkable" community. It's  an easy stroll to the Elementary school, Main St with it's many shops, yoga/meditation studio, multiple churches, restaurants, pharmacy, post office and police/fire station station. The Thruway is minutes away and LeRoy is centrally located between Rochester and Buffalo. The perfect midpoint.
